item.title: Shortened timeline to launch Phoenix replacement carries 'risk' with 'substantial' backlog, warns AG report - The Hill Times
item.description: Auditor General Karen Hogan said the backlog of pay issues needs to be eliminated as soon as possible in order to prevent transferring these unprocessed transactions to a new pay system.

item.title: Japanese Ambassador Yamanouchi plays Piano Man sayonara for Chef Shima - The Hill Times
item.description: Japanese Ambassador Kanji Yamanouchi’s personal chef wished Ottawa farewell on March 19 with one last showcase of Canuck-inspired culinary creations

item.title: New policy director named for Justice Minister Fraser's office - The Hill Times
item.description: Plus, Emergency Management and Community Resilience Minister Eleanor Olszewski has promoted a new director of operations in her office.

item.title: If Canada wants podiums, Ottawa must rebuild the places where sport begins - The Hill Times
item.description: Canada has no long‑term federal strategy for sport and recreation infrastructure, the physical backbone that makes participation possible and high performance sustainable.

item.title: Indigenous Services forecasts a ‘grim picture’ with $3-billion cut, sparking concerns of ‘widening gaps’ in programming - The Hill Times
item.description: The feds appear to be taking an economic approach to reconciliation, but ‘socioeconomic issues are not the only issues’ facing Indigenous communities in Canada, says political science professor Chadwick Cowie.

item.title: The war on Iran, and Trump’s many miscalculations - The Hill Times
item.description: Iran’s system has been created to outlast the superior weapons technologies of its enemies. The stockpile of missiles is doing havoc to the economies of America’s Gulf allies, the Strait of Hormuz is blocked to international shipping, and time is on Iran’s side.

item.title: Wrangling the Ranger rifle fiasco - The Hill Times
item.description: DND may have somehow spent nearly $20-million more buying guns in bulk from Colt Canada than they would have spent buying them individually from the manufacturer.

item.title: Canadian pride meets Finnish sisu - The Hill Times
item.description: Life in the North teaches resilience, co-operation, and responsibility, which is why closer co-operation between Canada and the Nordic countries feels both natural and timely.

item.title: House debates Poilievre’s auto pact plan - The Hill Times
item.description: Plus, Carney headlines the National Prayer Breakfast in Ottawa.

item.title: Canadians and Europeans are aligning—but where does their long-term threat outlook diverge? - The Hill Times
item.description: It would seem that our government understands the depth of the crisis, as do, perhaps, most political parties, but not necessarily the Canadian public.
